title: A row of the friction ledger
description: Every snag gets a row and lands in one of four places. The fields are the ones blind runs already write (pace-setter/lifecycle/runs/ch00-baseline/friction.jsonl), plus lands and case. Delight is recorded and never scored. Severity: 1 trivial, 2 annoying, 3 a real person hesitates, 4 they leave.

id.description: F001 from a blind run, S001 from the scripted harness.

lands.description: base: fixed in the runtime or page. small-base-change: one change to the standard, owned by the data model session. tailoring: an x_ for a family, not the project. declined: honestly not doing it, with the reason in happened. tbd: nobody has decided, which is what a blind run leaves.

case.description: The fixture or scripted step that holds it, so it cannot come back. Required once lands is not tbd, unless the row is delight.

state.description: landed: the case passes today. A row with no state is open.

trap.description: The trap in life/world/traps.md this row holds. A silently wrong trap with no row fails --check.
